To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed on-line scheduling algorithms are simple and efficient, and that the performance of the extended hybrid access protocol incorporating the on-line scheduling algorithms improves over the original reservation-based protocol.
the performance of a reservation based protocol can be improved by allowing reservations on more than one channel and using simple on line scheduling algorithms.

the performance of on-line scheduling algorithms for the hybrid reservation and pre-allocations protocols are comparable to off-line scheduling algorithms, with the advantage that the former are more amenable to real-time implementation and are more flexible.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a MAC protocol that is simple, efficient, and suitable for implementation in optical networks.
the design of media access protocols and their performance evaluation for optically connected networks.
developing and analyzing a hybrid protocol for WDM local area networks that can support multimedia applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the performance of the proposed protocol is superior to that of the existing reservation protocol for all types of traffic and all offered loads.
the performance of the extended hybrid protocol is comparable with that of the best off-line protocols, but with much less implementation complexity.
the performance of on-line scheduling algorithms for the reservation problem is comparable to that of off-line scheduling algorithms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of on-line scheduling is justified for WDM networks.
the performance of a hybrid reservation/pre-allocation MAC protocol is improved by the use of on-line scheduling.
the proposed protocol is a good candidate for implementation in a WDM network with on-line scheduling "Performance of a MAC Protocol for WDM Networks With On-Line Scheduling" (1997).
The main takeaway from our work is that
simple on-line scheduling can improve performance of a hybrid access protocol.
simple scheduling algorithms can be effective in WDM networks.
on-line scheduling algorithms can be used for reservation protocols in WDM networks.
